title: Google review removal and language: a historical accuracy-data audit

source_inputs.title: Google Maps reported moderation accuracy by EEA language: historical matched reports
source_inputs.scope: Publisher-reported automated-moderation accuracy across user contributions affecting EEA users; not review-only or Canadian case outcomes
source_inputs.selection: Two adjacent historical reports with the same 26-language Table 3.2.3; a bounded comparison, not a claim to contain the latest Google reporting

sources.text_fingerprint_encoding: UTF-8 with universal newlines normalized to LF; PDF fingerprint uses unmodified download bytes.
UTF-8 with universal newlines normalized to LF; PDF fingerprint uses unmodified download bytes.

source_inputs.rounding_note: Percentages and interval endpoints are used exactly as printed at whole-percentage precision; underlying unrounded values, sample sizes and sample overlap are not supplied here.

method: Unweighted matching by reported language. Closed-interval geometry uses printed whole-percentage endpoints. No pooling, re-estimated confidence intervals, sample-size recovery, p-values or removal probabilities.
limitations: Historical 2024H2/2025H1 matched reports; not the latest worldwide Google benchmark.
EEA user contributions across content/data types; not Canadian reviews or merchant removal requests.
Human evaluation is the source reference, not independently verified ground truth.
Unknown sample sizes, class mixture, covariance, repeated samples and underlying unrounded endpoints.
Overlapping/touching intervals do not prove no change; separated intervals are not formal significance tests here.
